items.title: Deadline to file Widerspruch against the Pflegegrad decision
items.quote: Innerhalb eines Monats ab Bekanntgabe kann gegen diesen Bescheid Widerspruch erhoben werden, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei: Pflegekasse bei der Musterquell Krankenkasse, Am Brunnenhof 2, 35390 Mustergießen.
items.computation: Bescheid is dated 20.11.2026 and no separate 'zur Post gegeben am' date is stated, so the posting day is 20.11.2026. The letter itself states delivery (Bekanntgabe) occurs on the 4th day after posting: 20.11.2026 + 4 days = 24.11.2026 (a Tuesday). This is a decision of a Pflegekasse, a social-law body under SGB XI/SGB X (not a Finanzamt), so the delivery day does not move even if it fell on a weekend or holiday (§ 37 Abs. 2 SGB X) — here it is a Tuesday anyway, so no adjustment is needed. The one-month Widerspruch period (§ 84 SGG) starts the day after delivery; the day of delivery (24.11.2026) is not counted (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB), and the period ends on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the delivery day (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB): 24.12.2026. That day is a Thursday and 24 December is a normal working day (not a statutory holiday), so no further shift under § 26 Abs. 3 SGB X / § 64 Abs. 3 SGG is required. Final deadline: 24.12.2026.
